question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        se.visit_id,
        ph.product_id,
        ph.page_name,
        se.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
      AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
visit_purchases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
product_views AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as page_views
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
product_added AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as added_to_cart
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
product_purchased AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, pe.page_name, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM product_events pe
    JOIN visit_purchases vp ON pe.visit_id = vp.visit_id
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY pe.product_id, pe.page_name
)
SELECT 
    pv.product_id,
    pv.page_name,
    pv.page_views,
    pa.added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(pp.purchases, 0) as purchases,
    pa.added_to_cart - COALESCE(pp.purchases, 0) as left_in_cart
FROM product_views pv
JOIN product_added pa ON pv.product_id = pa.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_purchased pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pv.product_id
